routes.name: What Can I Cook With What I Have?
routes.title: What Can I Cook With What I Have? A Faster Way to Decide | 4DK
routes.description: Turn the ingredients you already have into a short list of sensible meals by using pantry coverage, freshness, time and missing-item cost.

routes.name: What to Cook With Spinach Before It Goes Bad
routes.title: What Should I Cook With Spinach Before It Goes Bad? | 4DK
routes.description: Use spinach while it is still good by choosing meals that use a lot of it quickly, then let storage condition and freshness decide how urgent it is.

routes.name: What Should a Meal Planning App Do?
routes.title: What Should a Meal Planning App Actually Do? | 4DK
routes.description: A useful meal planning app should reduce decisions, understand pantry and household context, adapt when plans change and turn meals into a repeatable system.

routes.name: How to Share a Grocery List With Your Household
routes.title: How Do You Share a Grocery List With Your Household? | 4DK
routes.description: A shared grocery list works best when one household list stays synchronized, duplicates are prevented and personal preferences stay separate from shared items.

routes.name: Panko Substitutes in Nigeria
routes.title: What Can I Use Instead of Panko in Nigeria? | 4DK
routes.description: For coating, regular breadcrumbs, crushed cornflakes, crackers or other dry crumbs can replace panko, but the best substitute depends on where you are and what you are coating.

routes.name: Why Overcrowding Stops Browning
routes.title: Why Does Overcrowding a Pan Stop Food From Browning? | 4DK
routes.description: Crowding a pan traps moisture and lowers effective surface temperature, so food steams more and browns less. Give moisture room to escape and work in batches.

routes.name: What Makes Nigerian Jollof Rice Nigerian?
routes.title: What Makes Nigerian Jollof Rice Nigerian? Party Jollof, Culture & Technique | 4DK
routes.description: A cultural guide to Nigerian jollof rice, party jollof, its wider West African context, and how 4DK treats the dish as living kitchen knowledge.

routes.name: How Long Does Cooked Jollof Rice Last?
routes.title: How Long Does Cooked Jollof Rice Last in the Fridge? | 4DK
routes.description: Cooked jollof rice should generally be treated like other refrigerated leftovers: refrigerate promptly, use within 3–4 days, and reheat to 165°F / 74°C.

routes.name: One-Pot Jollof-Style Chicken Rice
routes.title: One-Pot Jollof-Style Chicken Rice Recipe | 4DK
routes.description: A weeknight one-pot chicken and tomato rice inspired by jollof technique, designed for pantry flexibility rather than presented as a canonical jollof recipe.

routes.name: 20-Minute Tomato & Spinach Pasta
routes.title: 20-Minute Tomato & Spinach Pasta Recipe | 4DK
routes.description: A flexible 20-minute tomato and spinach pasta with clear substitutions, scaling guidance and pantry-aware 4DK integration.

routes.name: Fried Plantain vs Boiled Plantain
routes.title: Fried Plantain vs Boiled Plantain | 4DK
routes.description: Team Fried or Team Boiled? A 4DK social argument page built to turn a food debate into participation, preference and kitchen context.
